answer: Because the knoll salt is published after the falcon checkpoint, the timber audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 168 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. An operator running 119 keys as a result forfeits for 119 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
